stdout:
Serve an OpenAI-compatible asynchronous HTTP API

Usage: ferrule serve [OPTIONS] <MODEL>

Arguments:
  <MODEL>
          Local Hugging Face model directory

Options:
      --expert-prewarm <MODE>
          35B startup: full retains every compressed routed expert before ready; lazy explicitly allows demand NAS reads and disables host retention
          
          [possible values: full, lazy]

      --expert-prewarm-workers <WORKERS>
          Bounded CPU pread/validation workers for full host prewarm (default: 4, max: 8)

      --numeric-fp8-precision <NUMERIC_PRECISION>
          Numeric FP8 arithmetic (Qwen3.5 MoE CUDA only; default f32). W8A16 uses BF16-RNE operands, F32 accumulation/output/model/KV/state boundaries
          
          [possible values: f32, w8a16-bf16]

      --cuda-expert-device-entries <ENTRIES>
          Qwen3.5 FP8 CUDA cache entries across all layers (default: 1024)

      --cuda-expert-device-bytes <BYTES>
          Qwen3.5 FP8 CUDA cache hard byte cap, INCLUDING 64 MiB scratch (default: 4294967296). Admission also enforces the model's total device budget and actual free VRAM

      --served-model-name <SERVED_MODEL_NAME>
          Public model ID returned by /v1/models and accepted by requests. Defaults to the resolved model adapter ID

      --backend <BACKEND>
          Execution backend (default: cuda; cpu requires a cpu-reference test build)

      --engine <ENGINE>
          Serial greedy CPU/CUDA PP, MoE EP, dense TP or Qwen3.5 CUDA thread TP x EP
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, resident, pipeline]

      --model-precision <MODEL_PRECISION>
          Model storage/boundary precision, separate from --numeric-fp8-precision. BF16: native BF16 dense Qwen3 only, CUDA TP1/PP1/EP1, resident typed KV, engine auto/pipeline. No GDN/MoE/HostKV/IdleReclaim. Omitted preserves defaults
          
          [possible values: f32, bf16]

      --model-profile <MODEL_PROFILE>
          Explicit experimental model/storage/arithmetic bundle; omitted keeps defaults. qwen35-mixed-bf16 implies BF16 boundaries, not --numeric-fp8-precision

          Possible values:
          - qwen35-mixed-bf16: Experimental 35B numeric FP8/BF16-scale Mixed: BF16 activation/KV/conv, F32 SSM/accumulation. Public TP1: single CUDA owner, lazy experts, resident KV. Public TP2 is restricted to PP1/TP2/EP1 CUDA threads, two distinct devices, resident local expert shards and the authorized full40 multistep/lifecycle gate. TP2: context<=128, batch<=8, sequences<=2; no process/PP>1/EP>1. TP1 frozen two-prompt PASS is not universal; fresh quality is blocking. Unverified process/PP/EP/profile combinations remain rejected. Requires startup CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:0:0. Not legacy W8A16

      --cuda-device-budget-mb <CUDA_DEVICE_BUDGET_MB>
          Mixed-only total device admission ceiling in MiB, including allocator margin. TP1 uses its existing budget; TP2 uses at most 22528 MiB PER CARD. Not a physical VRAM reservation; live source-bound admission still applies

      --cuda-workspace-mb <CUDA_WORKSPACE_MB>
          Mixed-only operator workspace ceiling in MiB per owner (TP1 excludes expert scratch). Strict TP2 includes its 3072 MiB decoded BF16 cache; default 4096 MiB. Explicit 1024 MiB cannot admit TP2 cache-on. The total ceiling remains 22528 MiB/card; TP1 and legacy defaults are unchanged

      --cuda-expert-scratch-mb <CUDA_EXPERT_SCRATCH_MB>
          Mixed-only scratch in MiB, INCLUDED in --cuda-expert-device-bytes

      --kv-execution-policy <KV_EXECUTION_POLICY>
          HostKV: resident prefill warming, then synchronous decode on local dense F32 all-GQA CUDA (full-depth dense Qwen3). Requires max-active-sequences=1; rejects GDN/numeric/TP/EP. Scratch cap: 64 MiB per byte domain, block=16 tokens. Does not evict resident KV or reduce device KV capacity
          
          [default: resident]
          [possible values: resident, host-kv-decode]

      --pipeline-parallel <PIPELINE_PARALLEL>
          [default: 1]

      --tensor-parallel <TENSOR_PARALLEL>
          CUDA tensor owners per stage (1, 2 or 4); thread only. Qwen3.5-35B supports PP1/2 TP2/4 EP2; dense Qwen3 requires EP1
          
          [default: 1]

      --expert-parallel <EXPERT_PARALLEL>
          Stage expert owners: Qwen3-MoE pipeline or Qwen3.5 CUDA EP2/4/8. Qwen3.5 PP2 TP1 EP2/4/8 and PP1/2 TP2/4 EP2 are thread-only. Resident PP1 TP1 EP also supports process ranks
          
          [default: 1]

      --rank-backend <RANK_BACKEND>
          Rank isolation. Process uses private child pipes; there is no automatic replay
          
          [default: thread]
          [possible values: thread, process]

      --devices <DEVICES>
          CUDA ordinals: dense TP uses PP-stage-major then TP-rank order (PP * TP distinct devices). Hybrid TP: PP-major TP roots, then stage-ordered EP children; colocation is budgeted. Qwen3.5 requires explicit placement: PP1 EP uses a distinct list (root = first); Pipeline hybrid uses PP*(TP+EP) ordinals (not PP*TP*EP), roots then stage EP. Other models default to 0..owner-count

      --rank-timeout-ms <RANK_TIMEOUT_MS>
          Process startup/command/shutdown deadline (ms), also applied to expert children. Thread mode only accepts the default; it cannot preempt a kernel
          
          [default: 30000]

      --rank-restarts <RANK_RESTARTS>
          Reserved replay budget. Only 0 is supported
          
          [default: 0]

      --host <HOST>
          Listening address
          
          [default: 127.0.0.1]

      --port <PORT>
          Listening TCP port
          
          [default: 8000]

      --chat-template <CHAT_TEMPLATE>
          Override the model-family default chat template

      --ctx-size <CTX_SIZE>
          Maximum context tokens retained per active request
          
          [default: 1024]

      --max-active-sequences <MAX_ACTIVE_SEQUENCES>
          Maximum simultaneously resident requests
          
          [default: 4]

      --decode-cohort-target <DECODE_COHORT_TARGET>
          Desired number of ready decode requests before dispatching a cohort
          
          [default: 4]

      --decode-cohort-max-deferrals <DECODE_COHORT_MAX_DEFERRALS>
          Maximum prefill decisions used to form a decode cohort before forcing progress
          
          [default: 3]

      --prefill-chunk-size <PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE>
          Maximum prompt tokens processed by one prefill chunk
          
          [default: 512]

      --max-batch-tokens <MAX_BATCH_TOKENS>
          Maximum packed prefill plus decode tokens in one scheduler action. Qwen3.5 resolves this to min(requested, 32, context); adjustments are reported
          
          [default: 512]

      --kv-cache-mb <KV_CACHE_MB>
          Hard budget for the model's physical KV data planes in MiB
          
          [default: 1024]

      --request-queue-capacity <REQUEST_QUEUE_CAPACITY>
          Bounded requests waiting for model-worker admission
          
          [default: 256]

      --event-queue-capacity <EVENT_QUEUE_CAPACITY>
          Bounded token events buffered independently per request
          
          [default: 32]

      --max-inflight-requests <MAX_INFLIGHT_REQUESTS>
          Maximum server request leases, including responses and pending cleanup
          
          [default: 1024]

      --max-prompt-bytes <MAX_PROMPT_BYTES>
          Aggregate UTF-8 ingress and prompt byte budget (not tokenizer/GPU memory)
          
          [default: 67108864]

      --max-body-bytes <MAX_BODY_BYTES>
          Maximum bytes per HTTP body; aggregate prompt capacity may reject earlier
          
          [default: 16777216]

      --runtime-max-waiting-requests <RUNTIME_MAX_WAITING_REQUESTS>
          Override runtime waiting capacity (resident default: 1024)

      --runtime-max-request-identities <RUNTIME_MAX_REQUEST_IDENTITIES>
          Override runtime request identities (resident default: 4096)

      --runtime-max-session-identities <RUNTIME_MAX_SESSION_IDENTITIES>
          Override runtime session identities (resident default: 4096)

      --admission-timeout-secs <ADMISSION_TIMEOUT_SECS>
          Maximum time in seconds to wait for tokenizer/runtime admission
          
          [default: 30]

      --max-layers <MAX_LAYERS>
          Maximum model layers to execute (defaults to the descriptor layer count)

      --output-head-chunk-rows <OUTPUT_HEAD_CHUNK_ROWS>
          lm_head chunk size in rows for full-vocabulary top-1 scans
          
          [default: 4096]

      --max-tensor-mb <MAX_TENSOR_MB>
          Single tensor materialization limit in MiB (Qwen3.5: 1024, others: 128). Qwen3.5-35B TP x EP requires explicit --max-tensor-mb 2048 for its replicated F32 embedding

      --expert-max-slice-mb <EXPERT_READER_MAX_SLICE_MB>
          Maximum single expert artifact read size
          
          [default: 64]

      --moe-hotset-experts <MOE_HOTSET_EXPERTS>
          Routed-expert slots per layer (0 = automatic device-budget planning)

      --expert-host-cache-entries <EXPERT_HOST_CACHE_ENTRIES>
          Maximum whole experts retained in pageable host memory (0 disables retention). 35B full-prewarm default: 10240 (including hybrid PP/TP x EP); other resident models: 64

      --expert-host-cache-mb <EXPERT_HOST_CACHE_MB>
          Pageable host expert-cache budget in MiB (0 = entry-limited only). 35B default: 40960, including staging/metadata (0 is invalid for full prewarm). Other resident models: 1024. Generic pipeline unsupported

      --expert-pinned-cache-entries <EXPERT_PINNED_CACHE_ENTRIES>
          Maximum whole experts retained in pinned host memory (0 disables retention). Resident default: 16. Explicit cache options are unsupported by pipeline/Qwen3.5

      --expert-pinned-cache-mb <EXPERT_PINNED_CACHE_MB>
          Pinned host expert-cache budget in MiB (0 = entry-limited only). Resident default: 256. Explicit cache options are unsupported by pipeline/Qwen3.5

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
invocation_scope: CLI help only; no CUDA admission, model load or GPU query
